g.title: LYN COLLINS – THINK ABOUT IT (the stolen record)

g.text: YOU BROKE INTO OUR HQ AND

g.title: BIBLE'S VERSES FINISH KRETE. HE HANDS OVER "THINK ABOUT IT". NEEDLE HASN'T TOUCHED IT IN DAYS... YOU GOT THE RECORD BACK!
